  CRITICAL  entry 0  SHA-1 signature [sig.sha1]
            The certificate is signed with SHA-1, which is no longer collision resistant, and current software rejects SHA-1 certificate signatures. On a self-signed CA certificate (a trust anchor) the signature is not checked during validation, so there it is informational.
            Evidence: signature_algorithm=SHA1-RSA
            Fix: Reissue the certificate with a SHA-256 or stronger signature.
